signature.name: VTask.SupportsStmt
signature.type: {K : Type u_1} -> {Γ : K → Type u_2} -> {Λ : Type u_3} -> {σ : Type u_4} -> (S : Finset Λ) -> Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ → Prop

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt is always True, regardless of S.
conventions.note: halt makes no jumps, so vacuously satisfies the predicate.

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto l) holds iff ∀ v, l v ∈ S.
conventions.note: Every value the label function can return must lie in S.

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch f q₁ q₂) holds iff VTask.SupportsStmt S q₁ ∧ VTask.SupportsStmt S q₂.
conventions.note: Both branches must independently support S.

conventions.statement: For push, peek, pop, and load, VTask.SupportsStmt S reduces to VTask.SupportsStmt S applied to the continuation; the tape operation itself adds no constraint.
conventions.note: These constructors cannot jump, so the predicate passes through to the continuation.

facts.statement: ∀ {K : Type} {Γ : K → Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (S : Finset Λ), VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ)

facts.statement: ∀ {K : Type} {Γ : K → Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (S S' : Finset Λ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ), S ⊆ S' → VTask.SupportsStmt S q → VTask.SupportsStmt S' q

facts.statement: ∀ {K : Type} {Γ : K → Type} {Λ : Type} {σ : Type} (S : Finset Λ) (q₁ q₂ : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ), q₁ ∈ Turing.TM2.stmts₁ q₂ → VTask.SupportsStmt S q₂ → VTask.SupportsStmt S q₁
